newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat ends down despite late buying.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat ends down despite late buying.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures ended lower, although late buying by commercials helped temper losses in spring wheat, traders said.
"Late today, we had another dose of interest in the March, with buying by CIS and Con Agra that helped (trim losses relative to KCBT and CBOT wheat)," a trader said.
Pressure on spring wheat came early from what traders said was a poor weekly export report and from feelings that spring wheat closed too high Wednesdayrelative to other markets.
MGE spring wheat closed 3-1/2 to 6-1/2 cents lower, with March down four cents at $3.90-1/4 per bushel.

LFG was the featured seller, shedding 2.6 million March bushels. Thursday's session marked the third straight day in which LFG sold at least one million March, and traders said the floor was rampant with speculation as to what the large volume of sales represented.

"We don't know who it's for, but we're wondering if it's the Canadians. We've had the market bounce up here a bit in recent days... so maybe these futures prices are attractive. I don't know," a trader said.
MGE barley futures did not trade and closed unchanged.
